description: Defines the WifiManagerInterface class with virtual methods and events for WiFi management in the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: WifiManagerInterface
classes.description: An interface class for WiFi management, including methods for scanning, connecting, and event callbacks.

methods.name: getQuirks
methods.description: Retrieves WiFi quirks based on provided parameters.

methods.name: getConnectedSSID
methods.description: Retrieves the SSID of the currently connected network.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the current WiFi network.

methods.name: getPairedSSIDInfo
methods.description: Retrieves info about the paired SSID.

methods.name: setSignalThresholdChangeEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables signal threshold change notifications.

methods.name: isSignalThresholdChangeEnabled
methods.description: Checks if signal threshold change notifications are enabled.

methods.name: onWIFIStateChanged
methods.description: Event callback for WiFi state changes.

methods.name: onSSIDsChanged
methods.description: Event callback when SSID list changes.

methods.name: onWifiSignalThresholdChanged
methods.description: Event callback for signal strength changes.
